Battle
On 25 November 1997, clashes occurred in the village of Rezallë near Skenderaj in the Drenica region. Fighters of the Kosovo Liberation Army (KLA) confronted security forces of the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia who were conducting operations in the area to suppress armed insurgents.
According to local reports, Yugoslav police units attempted to enter the village and search for suspected KLA members. KLA fighters positioned around the hills and outskirts of the village opened fire on the advancing units. A firefight followed that lasted several hours. The KLA used the mountainous terrain and local knowledge of the area to resist the advance.
After continued resistance from the KLA fighters, Yugoslav forces withdrew from the immediate area around the village.
Aftermath
Following the clash, Rezallë remained under the influence of local KLA units. The confrontation increased tensions in the Drenica region and contributed to the escalation of armed conflict between Yugoslav forces and the KLA in the months leading up to the wider fighting of the Kosovo War in 1998.
